document.title: [Title Excised] Plan to establish an Iraqi Element in Bin Ladin's Islamic Army
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: CIA Intelligence Report on a plan to establish an Iraqi element in bin Ladin's Islamic Army. Source: 9/11 Commission Report, Chapter 2, Endnote 54.

persons.name: Usama bin Ladin
persons.role: Leader of the 'Islamic Army', which was reportedly planning to establish an Iraqi element

mentions.quote: REQUESTEO THAT BIN LADIN REFRAIN.FROM ESTABLISHING SUCH A GROUP, BECAUSE THE NIF SUPPORTED SADDAM.

persons.name: Saddam Husayn
persons.role: Iraqi ruler, supported by the Sudanese NIF

mentions.quote: THE NIF WAS CONCERNED THAT SADDAM WOULD LEARN ABOUT THE ISLAMIC ARMY IRAQI ISLAMISTS

organizations.name: Islamic Army
organizations.notes: Bin Ladin's group, which was planning to add an Iraqi element composed of Iraqi Islamists. The text is badly garbled.

organizations.name: National Islamic Front
organizations.notes: Learned of the plan and asked Bin Ladin not to form the Iraqi group, because the NIF supported Saddam.

organizations.name: Central Intelligence Agency
organizations.notes: Issued the information report; it is not finally evaluated intelligence.

places.name: Sudan
places.significance: Base of the NIF, which was reportedly concerned about the plan (the text says 'SODANESE').

places.name: Iraq
places.significance: Origin of the Islamists to be organized into an element, and of Saddam.

events.description: CIA information report transmitted (TOT 011920Z AU[G] 97) on the plan to establish an Iraqi element in Bin Ladin's Islamic Army; the event dates inside the report are not legible.
The NIF learned of the plan and asked Bin Ladin to refrain from establishing the Iraqi group. The date is not stated.
Bin Ladin planned to establish an Iraqi element (Iraqi Islamists) within his Islamic Army.
The NIF learned of the plan and asked Bin Ladin not to form the Iraqi group, fearing Saddam would find out about the Iraqi Islamists in the Islamic Army.
The CIA information report on the plan was issued (TOT 011920Z AUG 97).

relationships.detail: The NIF asked Bin Ladin not to establish an Iraqi group because the NIF supported Saddam.
relationships.quote: REQUESTEO THAT BIN LADIN REFRAIN.FROM ESTABLISHING SUCH A GROUP, BECAUSE THE NIF SUPPORTED SADDAM.

relationships.detail: The NIF supported Saddam and feared he would learn of the Iraqi Islamists in the Islamic Army.
relationships.quote: THE NIF WAS CONCERNED THAT SADDAM WOULD LEARN ABOUT THE ISLAMIC ARMY IRAQI ISLAMISTS

relationships.detail: The document refers to Bin Ladin's Islamic Army.
The document title and text describe the Islamic Army as Bin Ladin's, and he is the one planning to add an Iraqi element to it.
relationships.quote: PLAN TO ESTABLISH AN IRAQI ... BIN LADIN ... ISLAMIC ARMY

relationships.detail: The NIF supported Saddam, which is why it did not want an Iraqi element formed in Bin Ladin's group.
The NIF learned of the plan and asked Bin Ladin to refrain from establishing an Iraqi group.
relationships.quote: AND REQUESTED THAT BIN LADIN REFRAIN FROM ESTABLISHING SUCH A GROUP

relationships.detail: The NIF is described as the Sudanese National Islamic Front.

key_claims: Bin Ladin planned to establish an Iraqi element in his Islamic Army.
The Sudanese NIF learned of the plan and asked Bin Ladin to refrain.
The NIF supported Saddam Husayn and feared he would learn about the Iraqi Islamists in the Islamic Army.
